card.name: Mirror-image chirality and enantiomer wording
card.fires_on: Words just before chirality terms such as homochirality or enantiomer, including the R or S label and the nearby words in sentences about mirror-image molecules.

modes.label: R/S enantiomer labels
modes.description: The letter R or S (or the closing parenthesis of S(–)) right before the word enantiomer for a named drug.

modes.label: Mirror-image passage
modes.description: Words in a passage on left-handed amino acids and mirror-image versions, leading into homochirality.
modes.example: the amino acids found in living things are almost<< universally>> "left-handed."

card.writes: It promotes pieces like ch, chir, hand and handed, which suggests it pushes the model to continue with chirality or handedness words.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say a molecule is a left- or right-handed mirror-image form.
